title: Early Termination Fee for a Notice to the Earliest Termination Date: Calculation
content:
**Months left.** Under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, the earliest termination date is the notice date plus the tier's notice period in calendar days, and the months left are the whole periods of 30 calendar days from that date to the renewal date, counted down and never below zero.

**Fee.** The early termination fee is the lesser of the tier's early termination fee months and the months left, times the monthly charge of the tier's monthly platform fee, rounded half up to the cent, and it is zero when no month is left.

**Order of the figures.** The fee is formed in one fixed order: what the monthly charge is made of is settled first, the monthly charge so formed is then multiplied by the months charged, and each multiplier is then applied to that product, the early termination fee being rounded half up to the cent as the last step.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Enterprise Plus program: platform fee 2950.00, notice period 90 days, early termination fee months 6)

| Renewal date, counted from the notice date | Days from the earliest termination date to the renewal date | Months left | Months charged | Early termination fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 400 days later | 310 | 10 | 6 | 17700.00 |
| 150 days later | 60 | 2 | 2 | 5900.00 |
| 119 days later | 29 | 0 | 0 | zero |
| 60 days later | none, the renewal date comes first | 0 | 0 | zero |
